documents.title: Synthetic bench study of phase-change heat release

sections.name: abstract
sections.text: The synthetic bench study measures heat release from a phase-change salt pack surrounded by a graphite enclosure. A fin array reduces temperature variation during discharge. No outdoor performance is reported.

documents.title: Synthetic study of reinforced silica coatings

sections.name: abstract
sections.text: This synthetic materials study tests a silica aerogel coating on a stainless steel tube. Ceramic mesh reinforcement reduces visible cracks after repeated thermal cycles. The study reports no full-scale installation.

sections.name: abstract
sections.text: A synthetic sodium-ion cell study compares a hard-carbon anode with two water-based cathode binders. The cell with binder B retains more capacity after 50 cycles in the fixture. These invented measurements are for retrieval tests only.

sections.name: abstract
sections.text: Синтетический тест описывает целлюлозную мембрану с пористым керамическим покрытием. Покрытие удерживает частицы наполнителя, но испытание не измеряет срок службы. Эти вымышленные данные созданы только для теста поиска.

sections.name: abstract
sections.text: A thermal storage module places a sealed phase-change salt pack inside a graphite shell. The shell spreads heat to an aluminum fin array during discharge. The module stores heat from a solar collector for release after sunset.

sections.name: abstract
sections.text: A silica aerogel layer covers the outside of a stainless steel pipe. A porous ceramic mesh supports the layer and limits cracking during thermal cycling. The coating reduces heat loss in the synthetic test rig.

documents.title: Synthetic sodium-ion cell and cathode binder

sections.name: abstract
sections.text: A sodium-ion cell uses a hard-carbon anode and a Prussian-blue cathode. A water-based binder holds cathode particles on an aluminum current collector. The synthetic test module operates at room temperature.

sections.name: abstract
sections.text: A cellulose membrane separates two liquid chambers in a synthetic filtration cell. A porous ceramic coating traps filler particles while water passes through the membrane. The fixture contains no measurements of service life.
